paragraphs.text:
While trying to keep a parallel course to the North Hanninah, 
you and Norman are forced to cross through hot springs and 
ravines. Around a bend, you hear a bizarre humming sound.

To go forward and investigate, go to 474. To retreat into a nearby 
cave to hide, go to 333.
